title.narrative: Maximize advocacy efforts and leading on a consistent narrative on gender equality and SRHR at the United Nations

Strategic and evidence-based advocacy analysis and products are developed to support cohesion and coordinated advocacy and negotiation efforts by Nexus members for high-level impact to uphold commitments to gender equality and SRHR as part of the ICPD and 2030 Agenda follow-up processes.

target.value: Provide strategic and evidence-based advocacy analysis, elements and substantive areas of focus for advocacy efforts, through Nexus delegations, joint statements and side events

actual.value: In 2023 Nexus initiated three joint statements that were signed by a total of 75 countries.

target.value: Provide strategic and evidence-based advocacy analysis, elements and substantive areas of focus for advocacy efforts, through Nexus delegations, joint statements and side events

actual.value: Members formed the Language and Strategy Working Group developed a compendium with language options (three levels: minimum, intermediate, and aspirational) on the SRHR topics, anchored in agreed language. The Outreach Working Group developed and started implementing a more structured approach to outreach to Member States that could be more publicly supportive of SRHR in UN fora. In 2022, the Secretariat facilitated support for two joint statements, one at CPD55 (58 countries supporting), the other at Third Committee (71 states supporting)

target.value: Provide strategic and evidence-based advocacy analysis, elements and substantive areas of focus for advocacy efforts, through Nexus delegations, joint statements and side events

actual.value: Nexus initiated a joint statement around the informal session of the General Assembly to celebrate the 30th anniversary of ICPD, which was signed by a record of 818 countries from across all regions. For comparison, in 2023 and 2022 a total of 75 and 74 countries respectively signed Nexus initiated joint statements.

title.narrative: Increase political support for gender equality/SRHR agenda in multilateral frameworks

A solid and flexible group of cross-regional government officials work cohesively, closely and jointly together for coordinated high-profile advocacy and outreach to mobilize broad political support to protect and advance commitments to gender equality/SRHR as part of the ICPD and 2030 Agenda follow-up processes at the United Nations

target.value: Reach out to government officials, through various initiatives, including joint statements, targeted outreach in New York and Geneva, as well as capital levels, to mobilize like-minded ministers to encourage their delegations to be more vocal on gender equality and SRHR at UN negotiations, and ministers from middle-ground countries.

actual.value: During 2023 Nexus reached out to 115 countries beyond its membership via a combination of bilateral outreach, support for the joint statements and a novel series of Ambassadorial Roundtables.

actual.value: During 2025 Nexus reached out to 148 countries beyond its membership via a combination of bilateral outreach, support for the joint statements, and a series of Ambassadorial Roundtables.

actual.value: The Secretariat and Members have explored new ways for genuine dialogue outside of the negotiating context. For examples, Members hosted Ambassadorial Roundtables (one in 2022, others will follow in 2023) and ongoing strategic outreach ahead of CPD56.
